messages:
Lina (CSM): Hey team — MeadowHealth wants to sign off the SLO acceptance as part of tomorrow's go-live. Need final confirmation on uptime/latency evidence and how credits will be handled if thresholds miss. Ping @Arjun for SRE, @Maya for onboarding, @Eve for contracts.
Arjun (SRE): Quick clarifying Q: are they on hosted-prod (us-west-2) or the dedicated pool? Credits/measurement differ by deployment.
Lina (CSM): Hosted-prod (us-west-2). Target = 99.9% uptime, p50 latency <=120ms, p95 <=350ms. They want the acceptance checklist and the evidence bundle today.
Maya (Onboarding PM): I can run the customer-facing enablement at 15:00 PT and hand over the runbook. Do we have the formal acceptance test set? Link: https://redwood.example.com/slo-acceptance/meadowhealth (internal).
Sam (Support): I already pulled their 7d dashboard export, will attach a tar with graphs + raw traces. s3://redwood-evidence/meadowhealth/7d-export.tar.gz
Arjun (SRE): I'll run the SLO-reporting job and attach Prometheus raw export. For credits calc we use the contract formula (example): credit = min(0.5, (1 - achieved/committed)) * monthly_fee. Need last 30d availability to compute actual.
Eve (Legal): Confirming the credit formula matches their signed MSA. Also we need customer sign-off on the acceptance doc before any credits are payable. I'll patch the onboarding checklist with the clause and share.
Maya (Onboarding PM): Training plan: 1) live walkthrough 15:00 PT 2) record + one-pager 3) runbook handoff + run a quick acceptance test. Lina — pls confirm MeadowHealth attendees.
Lina (CSM): Attendees: Dana (product lead), Rob (infra), Priya (security). Also asking to enable token-level tracing for 72h post-go-live to speed root-cause if issues surface. That needs compliance ok.
Arjun (SRE): Token tracing for 72h is doable, we'll scrub PII before sharing. Need confirmation DPA covers that.
Eve (Legal): DPA signed. Token tracing cleared from legal side; enable audit log retention per their compliance tier.
Sam (Support): After the session I will upload the recording + SLO dashboards to the support case and add a short FAQ: "how credits are calculated" + "escalation triggers".
DeployBot: job/slo-export-1769812345 succeeded — attached CSV: meadow-slo-export-1769812345.csv
Arjun (SRE): Action: I'll deliver the SLA report + raw metrics by EOD and run the credit calc once we have the 30d window.
Maya (Onboarding PM): Action: I'll host the 15:00 enablement and run the acceptance checklist live.
Eve (Legal): Action: I'll update the checklist and prep the signature request.
Sam (Support): Action: upload export + recording to the case after enablement.
Lina (CSM): I'll send the acceptance doc to MeadowHealth after your updates. Will also run a renewal-risk flag check after go-live to see if any notes should flow to AM. :thumbsup:
Lina (CSM): Thanks all — keeping this thread as the source of truth for evidence + sign-off.
thread_text_summary: Coordination thread for MeadowHealth SLO acceptance: confirm deployment (hosted), targets, evidence bundle location, enablement session, token tracing approval, legal sign-off and credit calculation formula. Actions assigned to SRE (report), Onboarding (training), Legal (contract patch), Support (upload artifacts), and CSM (send acceptance and run renewal-risk check).
